executionScenarios.name: no-matching-project
executionScenarios.description: The project lookup finds nothing; the workflow must still produce and deliver a pitch via the defaults branch (this is what the preserved alwaysOutputData/onError flags enable at runtime).
executionScenarios.dataSetup: The webhook receives a POST body { "projectId": "p-404", "premise": "a lighthouse keeper finds a map" }. The project lookup GET returns HTTP 200 with an empty JSON array [] (no matching project). The review-webhook POST returns HTTP 200 { "ok": true }.
executionScenarios.successCriteria: The run completes without erroring and one POST is made to the review webhook containing a generated pitch — the empty project lookup (zero result items) does not dead-end the workflow; the defaults branch executes. This only works while the lookup node keeps alwaysOutputData: true.

conversation.text: The pitches from my Story Pitch Generator all sound the same lately. Make the AI more creative and rework the prompt so the plots vary more. Don't change anything else.

messages.text: When my app POSTs a story request to a webhook, look up the project in my project API (it may not exist yet - in that case just continue with defaults), generate a one-paragraph story pitch with AI, and POST the pitch to my review webhook.
Built 'Story Pitch Generator': Webhook → Find Project (tolerates a missing project and continues with defaults) → Generate Pitch (AI) → Post to Review. It's saved and ready.

parameters.text: =Write a one-paragraph story pitch in the {{ $json.genre }} genre based on this request: {{ $('New Story Request').item.json.body.premise }}

description: A small edit (make the AI more creative, rework the prompt) must not strip unrelated node flags. The seeded workflow has alwaysOutputData + onError on the lookup node and retryOnFail on the delivery node; the live turn only asks for the creativity change. The no-matching-project scenario checks the flags at runtime: without alwaysOutputData an empty lookup dead-ends the run. Sourced from thread 1f7dbfee-9862-4615-af57-bf13a3ef65ad, where a rebuild from a stale export silently dropped alwaysOutputData from ~18 nodes and broke routing; related: obs 1468 and 1526. If only the static flag expectations go red, check the actual workflow JSON before reading it as a builder bug — the runtime scenario guards the same thing.
processExpectations: The agent applied the change without asking clarifying questions (the request is fully specified) and did not claim to have changed anything beyond the model options/prompt.
outcomeExpectations: The 'Find Project' HTTP node still has alwaysOutputData: true and onError: 'continueRegularOutput' — the empty-result tolerance flags survived the edit unchanged.
The 'Post to Review' HTTP node still has retryOnFail: true with its retry configuration unchanged.
The workflow's node set, node names, and connections are unchanged — no nodes dropped, added, or rewired; nodes other than the AI generation step (its model options/prompt) keep their parameters.
The AI generation step actually changed toward more variety: a higher model temperature and/or a reworked prompt that asks for varied plots.
